items.title: Sui Backs DATA With $30 Million as Network Plans to Retire Its Chain
items.summary: DATA balances are slated to carry over one-for-one onto Sui, but support for validator staking and smart contracts on the chain formerly known as Story will wind down.

items.title: Tom Lee sees $2 trillion wealth transfer fueling crypto demand as Bitmine buys more ether
items.summary: The Bitmine chairman said he expects younger investors to drive demand for digital assets as his ether treasury company inches closer to owning 5% of the total supply.

items.title: DeFi Development grows SOL holdings 12% as CHAD hits record highs
items.summary: DFDV added 22,070 SOL last week, lifting holdings to 2.59 million SOL, as its CHAD preferred stock hit record highs despite a selloff.

items.title: XRP treasury Evernorth’s shares rise 5% at Nasdaq opening print
items.summary: Evernorth’s share price rose by 5% as investors welcomed the Nasdaq debut of the first pure-play XRP digital asset treasury.
